title: Certify v0.14.0: documentation-correction round — every released part's prose re-derived against its own artifacts
description: This release corrects the documentation of all thirteen parts of the Certify corpus. No certified value changes, and no checker's verification logic changes: of the eight scripts touched, seven change only comments, docstrings or printed messages, one non-gating demonstration script has the rational point it queries corrected, and a machine-specific symlink to an absolute path outside the repository is removed. Every checker in the repository passes as before, and every mathematical result of Parts A through M stands unaltered. What changed is prose: artifact inventories that listed files the deposit does not contain, replay instructions that did not run as written, counts and labels contradicted by the shipped artifacts, and several claims that the artifacts refute. The round was produced by a retroactive cross-examination of every build-log decision against the prose of its own paper, followed by a re-derivation pass in which each checkable sentence was re-executed against the artifact rather than re-read, and an independent referee pass by a session that did no editing. Among the corrections: a Part A erratum-check script queried the wrong rational point and so appeared to refute the erratum it supports; a Part B quickstart carried a decompression command that would have destroyed three shipped proof archives; a Part H checker description was stated as if uniform across the two distances it covers; a Part J invariant table was described as separating thirteen graphs it does not separate; Part L's coverage and gold-value anchor claims were restated; and a Part M zero-field curvature claim was corrected, four of the ten zero-field transitions being certified local minima rather than saddles. CORRECTIONS.md in the repository lists the files this round changed and, for each part, its note and the build log recording that part's corrections decision by decision; Part J's build log was created in this round, no build-time log having been kept for v0.10.0. Computations carried out with Claude (Anthropic), directed by the author.
